lead.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, an open-weight frontier multimodal MoE
lead.summary: Meta published the weights for Muse Spark Open, the open-weights edition of its August Muse Spark release: an 816B-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts (42B active) that ingests text, images, audio and video. It ships with day-one support in Transformers, llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang and MLX, plus long-context inference and fine-tuning via TRL. Meta added extra safety post-training so the model can run standalone without system guardrails, and pitches agentic capabilities targeting high-end desktop hardware.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA readies the software stack as RTX Spark laptops ship
top_stories.summary: Ahead of the Oct 16 retail launch of RTX Spark laptops, NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B — a 74B MoE with 9B active parameters that fits in 24 GB via quantization-aware training, available through llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, Unsloth and LM Studio — and moved its PAIR distributed-inference router out of beta with llama.cpp support and RTX Spark integration.

top_stories.title: Black Forest Labs' FLUX.3 Image Klein lands in Diffusers on day one
top_stories.summary: The latest open image-generation model handles text-to-image and multi-reference image-to-image, adds a new layout-control feature, and ships base and quantized single-file variants with LoRA fine-tuning support.

top_stories.title: Apertus 1.5 extends the Swiss open models with vision, audio and a 4x longer context
top_stories.summary: The ETH Zurich/EPFL-backed Swiss AI Center extends the open 8B and 70B Apertus 1.0 weights with image and audio understanding, an optional thinking mode, a 4x longer context window, and improved instruction-following and tool use.

top_stories.title: First AA-AgentPerf-Local results land on the RTX Spark N1X laptops
top_stories.summary: Artificial Analysis' first local-agent benchmark of the new laptops: a 128 GB prototype Surface Laptop Ultra completed the Qwen3.8 27B workload in 18.7 minutes — close to DGX Spark's 17.3 and roughly 2x faster than an M5 Pro MacBook Pro, while an RTX 5090 desktop led at 4.9 minutes.

items.title: Training-free on-policy distillation aggregates specialist models with forward passes only
items.summary: Shows that consolidating specialist models into one student needs no gradient steps: separately tuned specialists' capabilities can be aggregated with forward passes only, eliminating the rollouts, teacher passes and training updates of standard on-policy distillation.

items.title: LoopAhead pipelines self-speculative decoding for looped language models
items.summary: Cuts the high decoding latency of shared-layer, parameter-efficient Looped Transformers via pipelined self-speculative decoding that avoids repeated sequential weight access per token.

items.title: Rethinking routing exploration in modern mixture-of-experts
items.summary: Examines how expert combinations and routing choices interact at fixed activation budgets in modern MoE designs that combine fine-grained expert segmentation with shared experts.

items.title: IFM/MBZUAI launch Jais 3: six Arabic-native open-weight models from 0.9B to 375B, Apache 2.0
items.summary: A fleet of six Arabic-centric language models (including a MoVA-36B-A4B) plus Jais Speech ASR, all built on IFM's K2 Horizon base. A full transparency release — weights, every training checkpoint, configs, recipes and audited Arabic benchmarks under Apache 2.0, with GGUF and MLX conversions for vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp.

items.title: NVIDIA ships Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B: open-weight omni-encoder VLM with 1M context
items.summary: Released in BF16 and NVFP4 under an open model license, the vision-language model interleaves Mamba-2, MoE and attention layers with a C-RADIO vision encoder, accepts image/video/text input, supports up to 1M tokens of context, and ships with day-one vLLM/SGLang/NIM support and native MTP speculative decoding.

items.title: Granite Switch 4.1: chat, decisions and speech from one endpoint
items.summary: IBM's open-weight 8B and 30B models combine chat, a general-purpose decision-making adapter and the fastest ASR model on the OpenASR leaderboard behind a single hosted endpoint, composable and extensible via Granite libraries.

items.title: Mistral introduces Timestral, its first time-series foundation models
items.summary: Four sizes from 5M to 209M parameters deliver state-of-the-art probabilistic multivariate zero-shot forecasting with covariate-aware attention, and run efficiently on CPUs.

items.title: NVIDIA opens a 2.8-trillion-token Indic pretraining pipeline
items.summary: NVIDIA published an open data-generation pipeline and 2.8-trillion-token corpus for continued pretraining of LLMs on Indic languages, covering twelve- and ten-language workflows built from English source documents.

items.title: Tokenmaxxing BERT: Hugging Face makes BERT-style tokenization roughly 50x faster
items.summary: A rewrite of Unicode normalization in the tokenizers library skips ASCII and clustered text, with end-to-end encoding speedups demonstrated on ModernBERT.

items.title: arcKode gives low-VRAM local sLLMs codebase-wide context via SQLite
items.summary: Indexes a whole repository into SQLite so small local models with limited VRAM can answer codebase-wide questions; launched on Show HN within the window.

items.title: Kokoro TTS distilled down to 9MB for local speech
items.summary: A teacher-in-the-loop distillation of the Kokoro text-to-speech model lands in a 9MB footprint, making fully local TTS viable on very small hardware.

items.title: PostHog launches an MCP server leaderboard
items.summary: A leaderboard ranking MCP servers, part of the fast-growing MCP tooling ecosystem for agent integrations, with notable Hacker News attention in the window.

items.title: Ollama v0.40.5 ships Nemotron 3.5 Super and Bolt support
items.summary: Ollama 0.40.5 updates llama.cpp and MLX with support for Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B hybrid Mamba-2/Transformer MoE VLM, 12B active, 1M-token context) and Bolt (74B/9B-active, tuned to fit a 24 GB GPU with a bundled drafter), adds cloud-hosted decision models, and fixes resuming OpenAI-compatible Responses conversations containing custom tool calls.

items.title: Open WebUI v0.12.2 repairs MinerU 4.x extraction, adds per-model routing
items.summary: Fixes broken document extraction on self-hosted MinerU 4.x servers (4.x removed the old parsing interface) and adds a {{MODEL_ID}} template variable for custom headers so downstream proxies can route or log per model; audit logs now record the requested model_id.

items.title: n8n 2.44.2 fixes the shared XML parser in webhook handling
items.summary: Patch releases across the 2.44 and 2.43 lines create a fresh XML parser for each webhook request body, closing a shared-state hazard for webhook-heavy self-hosted workflows.

items.title: QwenPaw v2.2.2 stable for local-model personal assistants
items.summary: The AgentScope-based personal assistant, which supports Ollama and other local backends, published its v2.2.2 stable release with console fixes from the UI redesign and hardened release CI.

items.title: Apple details distributed LLM inference with MLX and RDMA over Thunderbolt
items.summary: Apple's research post describes distributed frontier-model inference (including Muse Spark Open) across Mac Studio M5 Ultra machines using MLX's jaccl backend, which drives macOS 26.2's RDMA-over-Thunderbolt 5 interconnect for pipeline and tensor parallelism between Macs.

items.title: Tom's Hardware: the RTX Spark Superchip impresses in local AI, not in gaming
items.summary: With the first RTX Spark laptops shipping Oct 16, the GB10-derived N1X superchip in Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra tested strong in local AI inference on Windows-on-Arm, with 24 GB to 128 GB unified memory targeting agent workloads rather than graphics.

items.title: What hardware can actually run Meta's Muse Spark Open locally
items.summary: Meta pitches running the 816B MoE on two 512 GB M5 Ultra Mac Studios — not on sale until late October. A cost breakdown finds roughly $38,000 for four 256 GB Mac Studios, six to sixteen RTX 5090s for low-bit GGUFs, or a used 1 TB DDR4 EPYC server as the cheapest 4-bit option.

quick_hits.title: Ramp reaches $60B valuation as it pushes deeper into AI
quick_hits.summary: A $1.85B round co-led by Dragoneer, Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Sands Capital and Avenir Growth values the AI-first fintech at $60B, up from $44B four months ago.

quick_hits.title: Modal raises $750M Series D at a $15.75B valuation for AI infrastructure
quick_hits.summary: The serverless AI compute platform led by Accel triples its value in five months and crosses a $1B annualized revenue run rate.

quick_hits.title: Labelbox raises more than $100M for reinforcement learning and enterprise AI agents
quick_hits.summary: Financing, including a credit facility, funds the data-labeling platform's push into RL and enterprise agents; lead investor undisclosed.
